SELECT INFO.PROD_NAME ,INFO.PROD_RE ,INFO.ISSUING_WAY ,INFO.PROD_ID ,INFO.SET_DATE EDATE /**产品成立日期**/ ,PINDEX.ASSETS_VALUE /**资产净值**/ ,PINDEX.CAPITAL /**期末余额**/ ,PINDEX.UNIT_VALUE /**单位净值**/ ,PLAN.SETT_DATE /**本期收益结算日**/ ,PLAN.ACHIEVEMENT_BASIS /**业绩基准**/ ,PLAN.ACHIEVEMENT_BASIS_PROP /**业绩基准比例**/ ,PLAN.EXCESS_ACHIEVEMENT_PROP /**超额收益收取比例**/ FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INDEX PINDEX ON INFO.PROD_ID=PINDEX.PROD_ID AND PINDEX.STATUS='E' and #{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE}=pindex.VALUE_DATE LEFT JOIN DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN PLAN ON INFO.PROD_ID=PLAN.PROD_ID AND PLAN.DATA_STATUS='E' AND PLAN.SETT_DATE=#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE} where info.REP_PROD_TYPE in ('02','03') /**单产品或者子产品**/ AND INFO.STATUS='E'
AND INFO.PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT BONUS_PLAN_ID ,SETT_DATE ,PROD_ID ,BONUS_MODE ,PAYMENT_DATE ,ACHIEVEMENT ,EXCESS_ACHIEVEMENT_PROP ,ACHIEVEMENT_BASIS ,ACHIEVEMENT_BASIS_PROP ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SETT_DATE DESC ) RN FROM DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN WHERE 1=1 AND SETT_DATE<#{SETT_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND PROD_ID=#{PROD_ID,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) T WHERE RN=1
